messages:
sarah: Heads up — staging promote blocked by CI prefetch step, happening in the prefetch+cache job (3/3 failures). Putting a hold on today's promote window until we decide next step. Logs attached below. :eyes:
deploy-bot: Promotion blocked: staging -> canary. Reason: ci/cache-prefetch-timeout (job id: pipeline-1718907777-prefetch). See https://ci.internal/pipelines/1718907777 :warning:
raj: i'm digging in. i'm seeing a bunch of 504s from cache-proxy when it tries to fetch artifacts in parallel. suspecting upstream S3 throttling + aggressive concurrency from the prefetch worker.
nina: can we short-circuit by skipping prefetch for the promote? e.g. set PREFETCH=false for this run. it's risky but would be fastest to unblock.
david: i'd prefer pinning to last-green image instead of skipping prefetch. we validated image sha256:beefcafe earlier today in staging. pin to that and manual promote, then follow up with a proper fix. sarah ok to proceed if ops approves? :thumbsup:
sarah: yes — agree with pin+manual promote. need ops signoff for manual promote during change window and we should add a one-line release note explaining the emergency pin.
leah: ops ok for manual promote labeled "emergency-manual-pin" as long as rollback plan is documented. i'll help with the promote.
raj: quick attempt: increased cache-proxy retries from 3 -> 6 and scaled the prefetch job to 2 pods, re-ran the pipeline. still seeing intermittent 504s, looks like S3 rate limits when parallelism > 4. next option: re-run prefetch with sequential fetch (slower but successful).
nina: sequential prefetch adds ~2–3m to the job, fine for canary. if we pin now and promote, we can follow up with sequential prefetch hotfix and revert the pin.
david: i'll draft the release note: "Manual promote: pinned to last-known-good image (sha256:beefcafe) due to transient artifact prefetch throttling. Hotfix and revert planned." keep it short.
sarah: posting release note draft to the release-notes doc now.
leah: i'm about to trigger manual promote to canary with tag v2026.03.21-manual-pin (image sha256:beefcafe). will add a label and the release note reference.
deploy-bot: Manual promote request accepted. Initiated by leah. Reason: emergency pin due to ci/cache-prefetch-timeout.
deploy-bot: Manual promote progress: pulling images -> deploying -> healthchecks.
deploy-bot: Manual promote complete. Canary running image sha256:beefcafe. URL: https://canary.internal/health (green).
sarah: monitoring for 10m, checking error rates and p50/p95 latencies — so far no regression. marking unblock for the release.
raj: follow-up action items: 1) implement sequential prefetch fallback on retry, 2) add jitter to prefetch concurrency, 3) add S3 rate-limit retries with exponential backoff. i'll open a PR with the change and a postmortem note.
nina: +1 on the backoff; also recommend an observability metric for prefetch 504 rate.
david: once raj's PR merges, we'll schedule a quick revert of the manual-pin in the next minor release. adding to release tracker.
sarah: thanks all. good quick triage. :white_check_mark:
